question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Transgression
solution:
The correct answer is "Violation."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The word **"Transgression"** means an act that goes against a law, rule, or code of conduct; an offence. (अतिक्रमण, उल्लंघन)

 
 
• Example: *Adolescence is a period marked by fascination with the **transgression**__ of rules.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of "Transgression" is "Violation."
 
• The word "Violation" means the action of violating someone or something. ((मर्यादा का) उल्‍लंघन, हनन)
 __
 
• Example: *It was clear that they had not acted in **violation**__ of the rules.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 
• Success: **the fact that you have achieved what you want; doing well and becoming famous, rich, etc. (अभीष्‍ट की प्राप्ति हो जाने की स्थिति; यश, धन आदि की प्राप्ति, सफलता, कामयाबी)
 
• **Virtue: **behaviour that shows high moral standards. (उच्‍च नैतिकता (वाला आचरण))
 
• **Metamorphosis**: a complete change of form (as part of natural development). ((प्राकृतिक विकास-प्रक्रिया के अंतर्गत) पूर्ण रूप से आकृति में परिवर्तन; रूपांतरण)
